name: Alteri
homeworldtt:
Location: 6.5 hours travel from Center, Galactic NorthWest.

Teris is a world with a less humid climate than that of Earth.
It hosts less tropical and temperate zones, leading to less viable farmland.
Much of the planet's surface is located in desert or tundra regions.
affiliationtt:
The Alteri are an affiliate race of the Peacekeeper Alliance.
Because the Alteri do not yet have a stable government and have not yet achieved a spacefaring presence,
the Peacekeeper Alliance established the first Stewardship Member status for Teris.
While they are entitled to defensive aid from external threats,
the Alteri do not yet have the right to participate in matters of governance.
physicaltt:
Wirey.
Flexible frames.
Extra Joints.
Malleable inner organs and a tendency toward extra skin gives the impression of advanced age in their natural state.
baseStatusDesctt:
Alteri receive the following modifiers:
+1 FOC
+1 CAP
-1 CON
scalingStatusDesctt: Alteri receive a bonus of +1 SUB per Racial Level
racialDesctt:
Alteri can mimic the general physical characteristics of other races.
This is not as specific as imitating a specific creature’s appearance,
but they can appear to be a member of that race and alter basic appearance traits such a build, weight, height, and eye, hair, or skin coloration.
Once the Alteri has reached racial level 5,
they can spend 1 hour in contact with a specific entity in order to mimic that creature's appearance.
description:
The history of Teris is one of constant civil war as its factions battle for control of the world's arable farmlands.
Because they have not been able to establish a stable world government,
the Alteri homeworld remains largely disconnected from the galactic region's politics.
The technology of Teris has reached the late Modern era,
utilitzing weapons and tactics reminiscent of WWII.

name: Aquata
homeworldtt:
Location: 10 hours travel from Center, Galactic South.

Aquios is an Ocean world.
affiliationtt:
The Aquata are a member race of the Peacekeeper Alliance.
Their generally pleasant temperament has earned them an excellent reputation.
They are often the go-to mediators for any sort of conflict resolution.
physicaltt:
Gills.
Marine features.
Frequently referred to as Fishmen by other races,
the Aquata have adapted to underwater life.
All Aquata can breathe water,
and most can tolerate air atmospheres.
personalitytt:
Calm.
Thick-skinned.
Aquata see the best in people and are incredibly difficult to offend.

name: Ardian
homeworldtt:
Location: 5.5 hours travel from Center, Galactic NorthWest.

Rvall is a temperate planet, ravaged by war.
Much of the ecology has suffered extreme damage due to the prolonged conflict.
affiliationtt:
The Ardians are a member race of the Peacekeeper Alliance.
Their world was located in a strategic location in the Great War.
As a result, they suffered massive damage to their planet and people.
To make ammends for the destruction, they were offered a place in the Alliance and resources to help rebuild.
As a direct result, a majority of Peacekeeper races feel protective toward the Aridans.
physicaltt:
Short. Average height: 4'9\".
Ardians have a short layer of fur covering a majority of their bodies, though often it is thin enough to be nearly invisible.
Large, rounded ears.
Their eyes are typically of a very dark color with very little visible sclera.
personalitytt:
Ardians feel more fear than any other known race.
While some can be motivated by the simple fear of bodily harm,
Ardians often fear the loss of loved ones far more than death.

name: Azuri
homeworldtt:
Location: 11.5 hours travel from Center, Galactic NorthWest.

Azure is a grimy world, rife with pollution and poorly maintained infrastructure.
affiliationtt:
The Azuri are a member race of the Peacekeeper Alliance.
A former member of the ill-fated Deckan Imperium,
most members of the Peacekeeper Alliance have been historically wary of the Azuri.
As the other races have gained understanding of the Azuri culture,
relations have become less strained.
physicaltt:
Tall. Average height: 6'6\"
Fangs and forked tongues.
Azuri prefer their food served live.
Patches of green, yellow, or brown scales running along parts of their arms, legs, torso and face.
Their eyes are typically an off-orange color with a piercing gaze.
personalitytt:
As part of their culture, Azuri choose a pursuit when the reach adulthood.
Azuri define their life by their pursuit, seeking to fulfill their life's purpose.
Other races tend see this behavior as an insatiable greed.

name: Boxlor
homeworldtt:
Location: 41.5 hours travel from Center, Galactic NorthWest.

Darktopia is a tropical world, home to a diverse ecosystem.
affiliationtt:
The Boxlor are an affiliate race of the Peacekeeper Alliance.
Darktopia is a planet far from the defensive borders of the Alliance.
During the displacement event, the Alliance and residents of Darktopia were forcibly introduced.
Because of the distance between them and the lack of Darktopian central government,
the Alliance conferred a Peacekeeper+ membership on darktopia.
This allows Darktopians to attend the Academy and trade with PK worlds, but nothing more.
physicaltt:
Tall. Average height: 10\"
Thick builds, quite bulky.
Boxlor have thick skin colored in greens and browns.
Boxlor frequently use piercings to demonstate their worship of their deities and natural spirits.
personalitytt:
Boxlor tend to be taciturn.
This trait may be a part of their heritage or a result of their enslavement,
but Boxlor often communicate non-verbally as much as possible.
Boxlor often wear piercings to proclaim their faith and give a general sentiment about how they are feeling.

name: Cetryu
homeworldtt:
Location: 9 hours travel from Center, Galactic NorthWest.

Cetria is a highly advanced world.
affiliationtt:
The Cetryu are a member race of the Peacekeeper Alliance.
Cetria was a highly optimized and futuristic society.
Unfortunately, as a result of the Great War*,
Cetria's governing body was offworld when their population was wiped out.
Having been reduced from a 5+ billion population to roughly 10 million,
the Cetryu are caught in an effort to reroute their infrastructure and attempt to recover.
physicaltt:
Cetryu possess abnormally large, wet eyes with a set of two distinct eyelids, one vertical that is somewhat transparent and a second, skin-like set.
Frequently wear eye covering s(partial mask, goggles, etc).
Their tongues are much longer than most humanoids and are sticky, extending to approx half a meter in length.
Many Cetryu can also cause their fingertips to swell and become adhesive, though this has little practical application in modern times.
personalitytt:
The Cetryu are a race of scientists and technicians.
Most Cetryu consider tinkering and inventing to be an enjoyable pastime.
Cetryu are uncomfortable in low-technology environments.
Cetryu also possess an intense curiosity about anything they do not understand.

name: Construct
homeworldtt:
Location: No Known Route.

Gwyr is a world that would be considered dead to any non-mechanical race.
Infrastructure on this world is suited only to artificial life forms.
affiliationtt:
The Gwyr are an affiliate race of the Peacekeeper Alliance.
Not all constructs are androids and not all androids are Gwyr.
The Gwyr represent the interests of artifically created races within Peacekeeper space.
physicaltt:
More often than not, a construct's design will simulate the humanoid form, bipedal with two arms, two legs, a torso and a head.
Because of their nature, however, more unusual models are definitely possible.
As a general rule, a starting construct should have 2-4 limbs, a central body/torso, and a somewhat vulnerable core, such as a processing unit or brain.
For any design that differs from the humanoid norm, get permission from your narrator in advance before implementation.

but they can appear to be a member of that race and alter basic appearance traits such a build, weight, height, and eye, hair, or skin coloration.
Once the Alteri has reached racial level 5,
they can spend 1 hour in contact with a specific entity in order to mimic that creature's appearance.
description:
The history of Teris is one of constant civil war as its factions battle for control of the world's arable farmlands.
Because they have not been able to establish a stable world government,
the Alteri homeworld remains largely disconnected from the galactic region's politics.
The technology of Teris has reached the late Modern era,
utilitzing weapons and tactics reminiscent of WWII.

name: Vyrek
homeworldtt: Location: 12 hours travel from Center, Galactic NorthWest.
affiliationtt: <html>The Vyrek are a member race of the Peacekeeper Alliance.
physicaltt:
Vyrek are all horned beings, the exact placement on the head and shape of the horns varies from Vyrek to Vyrek.
Approximately 60% of Vyrek possess a whip-like tail, often spiked at the end.
Less than 10% of Vyrek appear with bat-like wings.
Vyrek are carnivorous, with razor sharp teeth.
Vyrek in possession of a demon have eyes that glow faintly with a color related to the nature of that demon and, as long as the demon remains with them, their hair will grow tinted with that color as well.
